chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Warsaw, 2012. Euro semi-final: Germany against Italy. Montolivo launches a long ball. Mario Balotelli beats the offside trap, chests it down, and... bang! Top corner!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He waits on the shoulder of the last defender, then sprints in behind. One touch, head down, and he hits it with his laces.

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: Manuel Neuer does not even move. Two goals for Balotelli, and Italy are in the final!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn, strikers: stay on the shoulder of the last defender. When you break through, look up, and strike it hard.
